26 A range check stores its data as scalars, and a specialization maps a type to them:
27 `element_type` is the scalar, `size` the number of scalars per value, `load` and `store` the
28 conversions between a value and `size` consecutive scalars. The primary template covers a
29 scalar type, with `size` equal to one. A specialization also keeps whole a result that follows
30 the protocol of structured bindings, which the primary template splits into its members.
31

720 //======================================================================================================================
721 /*!
722 @def TTS_ULP_RANGE_CHECK
723 @ingroup test-precision
724 @brief Checks a function against a reference over a range of inputs, within a ULP distance.
725
726 Generates inputs with `Producer`, calls `RefFunc` and `NewFunc` on each of them, and records the
727 [ULP distance](rationale.html#ulp) that tts::ulp_check measures between the two results. The
728 distances are gathered in a histogram, and the check passes if none exceeds the bound given after
729 `NewFunc`.
730
731 @groupheader{Arguments}
732
733 For a unary function, `RefType` and `NewType` are its argument type.
734
735 For a function with several arguments, `RefType` and `NewType` are tts::types lists between
736 parentheses, in call order. `Producer` is either a list between parentheses of a generator per
737 argument, or a single generator that each argument uses on its own. A single tts::sample(4096)
738 for two arguments thus makes 16777216 calls.
739
740 @groupheader{Number of calls}
741
742 The check runs every combination of the values its arguments take. tts::sweep gives every value
743 in its range, and tts::sample its `n` values, or every value of a range that holds fewer.
744
745 The other generators together give the smallest number of values per argument whose combinations
746 reach 4096: 4096 values for a single argument, and 64 for each of two. A generator receives the
747 index of each value and the number of values of its argument.
748
749 The number of calls is the product of these counts, multiplied by `N` under `--loop=N`. A check
750 whose product does not fit in `std::size_t` fails without running. Memory does not grow with the
751 number of calls, so tts::sweep checks each float but NaN, once by default.
752
753 @groupheader{Range options}
754
755 `--valmin` and `--valmax` narrow the values of tts::sweep, tts::sample, and tts::randoms in every
756 check of the run to the ones between them, for an argument of an integer or floating-point type.
757 A check prints a note when they narrow an argument, and passes without a call when they
758 leave an argument no value.
759
760 @groupheader{Threads}
761
762 Compiled with OpenMP, a check whose generators are all tts::sweep or tts::sample splits its calls
763 between the threads of OpenMP, whose number `OMP_NUM_THREADS` sets. `RefFunc` and `NewFunc` are
764 then called from several threads at once, and neither the report nor what they draw through
765 tts::random_value depends on the number of threads.
766
767 @groupheader{Result types}
768
769 `RefFunc` returns the element type that the result of `NewFunc` holds, or the check does not
770 compile. A reference computed in `double` for a `float` function thus returns its result cast to
771 `float`.
772
773 `NewType` may hold several values of `RefType`, as a specialization of tts::adapter describes.
774
775 A result is compared member by member, each member with its own histogram, when tts::adapter has
776 no specialization for its type and that type is:
777
778 - `std::pair` or `std::tuple`,
779 - or a type that specializes `std::tuple_size` and provides a `get` found by argument-dependent
780 lookup.
781
782 The check then takes a bound for all members or a bound for each member.
783
784 @groupheader{Report}
785
786 A check that fails prints its histogram, and `--verbose` prints it for every check. Each bucket
787 shows the first input whose distance falls in it. When `NewType` holds several values, that input
788 is marked between stars within its group. `--ulpmax` replaces the bounds of every check of the
789 run.
